source.subject: feat(acceptance): complete DG2 local browser workflows

scope.fixture_privacy: only generated, synthetic PPTX/DOCX/WAV media; generated files remain ignored
scope.service_lifecycle: the Windows run starts API and Vite as explicit child processes and stops both exact PIDs in finally; CI retains Playwright-owned isolated services
scope.provider_boundary: synthetic adapters are enabled only by the explicit E2E environment flag; real provider, Presenter and HeyGen flows remain disabled without their separately documented authorization flags

S1.description: two-page local-audio smoke through project creation, import, parse/match, narration confirmation, WAV alignment, subtitles, timeline conflict, authoritative preview, preflight, async render, refresh/recovery and production package

S8.description: eight-page local-audio production package through the same browser workflow, including cancellation/retry, pause/resume, duplicate submit de-duplication and final artifacts

browser_evidence.failure_context: each scenario writes candidate, run, scenario, console errors and network failures to dg2-browser-context.json; successful scenarios have empty error collections

verification.browser_boundary_and_lifecycle: 3 passed: real-flow finite-boundary policy, project close/reopen lifecycle, async render reload and pause/resume
verification.browser_s1_s8: 2 passed in 2.2m against controlled local API/Vite services
verification.python_focused: 48 passed: fixture generation, timeline/graph/quality/recovery routes, storage/job/rendering units
verification.python_static: Ruff passed; mypy passed for 12 changed API/rendering/E2E source targets
verification.web_static: TypeScript noEmit passed; authoritative preview and preview workspace components: 6 passed
verification.diff_hygiene: git diff --check passed before source commit
verification.ci_definition: GitHub Actions CI executes pnpm e2e and uploads test-results/playwright-report evidence on Ubuntu and Windows; the same Playwright scenario definitions are used locally and in CI

gate_decision.unexplained_real_flow_skips: PASS: the three privileged real flows have finite authorization, environment flag and next-gate destinations in tests/e2e/real-flow-policy.ts
gate_decision.remaining_fault_coverage: network-disconnect and API-process-restart browser fault injection is deliberately retained for DG5 fault-recovery depth; it is not an unbounded skip and does not invalidate the DG2 local workflow gate

residual_risks: The S1/S8 evidence uses explicit synthetic adapters and generated media; no real Provider, Presenter or HeyGen credentials were invoked.
Local Windows runs use explicit service cleanup because the console launcher can retain media-worker child handles; CI keeps Playwright-owned isolated service startup.
Signed Windows RC, manual audiovisual review, real service cost controls, S50 scale and long soak remain later gates.
